Theme

Latin word

recitō

recitō, recitāre, recitāvī, recitātum

verb, first conjugation

read aloud, read out; recite; read out to an audience

In this lexicon

  • read aloud

    the recommended word · classical · Plaut. Pers. 500: at clārē recitātō; Cic. Att. 8.9.2 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 27, 34

  • recite

    also used · classical · Hor. Ars 438: Quīntiliō sī quid recitārēs; Cels. 3.18 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 31

Examples

  • Cedo sānē mihi. — At clārē recitātō. — Tacē, dum pellegō.

    Give it here, then. — But read it out loud. — Quiet, while I read it through.Plaut. Pers. 500

    In the entry for read aloud

  • ōrātiōnem Graecam Latīnamve clārē et intentē nōn tam vōcis causā quam stomachī legō

    I read a speech, Greek or Latin, aloud and with effort, not so much for my voice’s sake as for my digestion’sPlin. Ep. 9.36.3
